problem: Two rays on opposite sides of a reference line with adjacent angles totaling two right angles form one straight line.

proof_idea.original: The source supposes a different continuation and uses I.13 plus the whole-versus-part common notion.
proof_idea.analytic: Numeric supplementary angles imply opposite normalized cosines. Opposite determinant signs fix the sine orientation, yielding antiparallel ray vectors.
